description: Migrate from RankMath or Yoast. RUN dry_run=true FIRST for RankMath and read warnings. A real (non-dry-run) RankMath import is refused unless seo_status lists migrate_external_targets (older plugins import redirects to old staging hosts enabled); update the plugin first. Default: per-post/term meta, schema and redirects are migrated and { posts_migrated, terms_migrated, redirects_migrated, errors, dry_run, changes: [{ object, id, key, value }], unsupported: [{ object, id, title, reason }] } is returned; with dry_run=true nothing is written and changes lists what would be. A per-post dry run is only sent when seo_status lists the feature migrate_dry_run (cvrt-seo-manager 1.15.0+); on an older plugin, which would WRITE, the tool refuses and sends nothing. With settings=true (RankMath only) ONLY the global titles/meta/sitemap/robots settings are ported instead, and dry_run=true reports { written, skipped, dry_run } without writing. RankMath redirects (feature migrate_external_targets): a target on the site's own host is imported relative; a target on any other host is listed in warnings: [{ object, code, source, target, host, enabled, imported, message }] (code external_target) and imported disabled unless allow_external_targets=true (run the dry run first and check those hosts; an old staging host is the usual case). Only home and siteurl count as the site's own: a host seen in an absolute RankMath source is reported (code source_host, with rankmath_ids; its sources as foreign_source, not imported) and counts as own only when passed in own_hosts.

allow_external_targets.description: Import RankMath redirects whose target is on another host ENABLED (default false: imported disabled, listed in warnings either way). Needs the feature migrate_external_targets; the tool refuses it on an older plugin, which would ignore it.

dry_run.description: Compute and list every change, write nothing (default false). Honoured by the meta migration from cvrt-seo-manager 1.15.0+; older versions write anyway.

own_hosts.description: Hosts that ARE this site besides home and siteurl (an old staging or live domain named in the dry run's source_host warnings). Sources and targets on them are imported as paths. Needs the feature migrate_external_targets.

settings.description: Port the global settings instead of the meta (RankMath only, default false)

name: seo_import_migrate
